name: guide-bilingual-sync
title_zh: 英日双语指南同步器，改一边另一边跟着动
tagline_zh: LuckyCat 指南站英日双版互相同步，新增日文页自动补进英文目录。不用手动比对两份文件，改完一边提交。
tagline_en: Keep LuckyCat guide sites in sync across English and Japanese. Add a Japanese page and it's tracked for the.
desc_en: Add or maintain English and Japanese versions of the LuckyCat guide sites. Use when enabling bilingual guides, translating pages, or synchronizing guide changes in either direction, including Japanese additions into English.
why_zh: 它把「双语一致性」当成一个可维护的状态机，而不是翻译记忆库。每次变更都双向追踪。
why_en: Treats bilingual consistency as a maintainable state machine, not a translation memory. Changes tracked both ways—Japanese.
limit_zh: 只认 LuckyCat 指南站目录结构；不负责翻译内容本身，只同步页面存在与链接关系。
limit_en: Only works with LuckyCat guide site structure. Syncs page existence and links, not translated text. Other repos need directory conventions aligned.
title_en: Bilingual guide sync: edit one side, the other follows
